Question Choices: Expand 10^3 as repeated multiplication: __ x __ x __
Hints: The base is the repeated factor; a positive whole-number exponent counts those factors.
Solution: 10^3 has base 10 and exponent 3. It means 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000. Every blank is 10.
